changelog:
### v2.3.3 - Live Inbox Refresh and Console Error Fixes
- Fix: Inbox now auto-refreshes on live servers without page reload (no-cache headers added to AJAX)
- Fix: Added cache-busting timestamp to every inbox poll request
- Fix: Script tags stripped from HTML emails before display (prevents Blocked script execution console errors)
- Fix: Email viewer switched from doc.write() to srcdoc
- Fix: JS file now uses filemtime() for cache-busting so stale JS is never served after an update
- Improvement: Plugin version bumped to 2.3.3
